title: Sirui Expands Its Full-Frame Aurora Lineup With Fast 15mm f/1.6 and 24mm f/1.4 Primes
summary: Sirui expands full-frame Aurora lineup with fast 15mm f/1.6 and 24mm f/1.4 prime lenses
detailed: Sirui just added two new additions to its full frame autofocus Aurora lens lineup: the Aurora 15mm f/1.6 ultra-wide lens and the Aurora 24mm f/1.4 wide angle lens.

Optically designed for architectural photography, tight interior spaces, vlogging, and low-light night scenes, the Aurora 15mm f/1.6 pairs a 15mm ultra-wide perspective with a bright f/1.6 maximum aperture.

The Aurora 24mm f/1.4 provides a versatile wide angle perspective that captures environmental context while keeping subjects naturally proportioned, offering a wider field of view than a 35mm without the exaggerated perspective of ultra-wide lenses.
The SIRUI Aurora 15mm f/1.6 is priced at $599, while the SIRUI Aurora 24mm f/1.4 is priced at $499.
sentences: Sirui just added two new additions to its full frame autofocus Aurora lens lineup: the Aurora 15mm f/1.6 ultra-wide lens and the Aurora 24mm f/1.4 wide angle lens.
Living up to the Aurora foundation, both lenses combine bright maximum apertures, STM autofocus performance, and dedicated video-friendly ergonomics for hybrid creators.

Optically designed for architectural photography, tight interior spaces, vlogging, and low-light night scenes, the Aurora 15mm f/1.6 pairs a 15mm ultra-wide perspective with a bright f/1.6 maximum aperture.
The fast aperture provides improved light gathering in dim environments, allowing creators to shoot handheld without relying on higher ISO settings or slower shutter speeds.

The Aurora 24mm f/1.4 provides a versatile wide angle perspective that captures environmental context while keeping subjects naturally proportioned, offering a wider field of view than a 35mm without the exaggerated perspective of ultra-wide lenses.

With its bright f/1.4 aperture, the lens offers strong low-light performance alongside precise depth-of-field control, making it well-suited for interviews, weddings, documentary work, commercial video, and run-and-gun shooting.
The SIRUI Aurora 15mm f/1.6 is priced at $599, while the SIRUI Aurora 24mm f/1.4 is priced at $499.
Both lenses will launch initially in Sony E and Leica L mounts in 2026, with Nikon Z and Fujifilm X mounts scheduled for Q1 2027.
